data.text: Natural mode, 10 questions before and 10 after, prompt never names search, Sonnet subagents that load CLAUDE.md but get no prime (no SessionStart hook in a subagent). Before: search used by 1 of 10, at step 9 after grep. After the one-line change in the CLAUDE.md section: 0 of 10. Correct 9/10 both times; median added context 10.9k vs 10.2k; median 44 s both. Every agent opened with grep over the whole repository, not .kadence/, and 4 of 20 answered from docs/ on the owner's disk, which a clone does not have. So criterion 7 fails: a line in an instruction file does not change the first move. prime's new line is untested here because subagents never see prime. Timing: prime 90 ms after the change.
